scope: Original 2024 research, paper v2; living release/model cards are supplementary documentation

purpose.description: Parent corpus: web pretraining. Edu subset: educational-value selection.
purpose.uncertainty: Educational selection is not the same objective as narrative consistency.

source_and_unit.description: Web documents from Common Crawl; the original research describes extraction, filtering and deduplication.
source_and_unit.uncertainty: This review does not inspect all later revisions or reconstruct individual documents.

topics_and_knowledge.description: The reported Edu mix favors education/teaching and history/culture/politics, while reducing business/finance/law, entertainment and travel-related clusters relative to the parent corpus.
topics_and_knowledge.uncertainty: No task/topic prevalence estimates were independently measured here.

reasoning_operations.description: Knowledge/reasoning benchmark results are available; coverage of each Nous operation is unmeasured.
reasoning_operations.uncertainty: Aggregate benchmark improvement cannot certify a specific operation in the corpus.

supervision_and_solution_structure.description: Document text supplies a pretraining signal. Per-record reasoning demonstrations, exercises and verified solutions have not been annotated here.
supervision_and_solution_structure.uncertainty: A document about mathematics need not require a mathematical inference.

language_and_communication.description: English web text; linguistic registers and communication styles need a sampled audit.
language_and_communication.uncertainty: Educational score does not give a syntax/readability distribution.

quality.description: Edu uses a school-focused 0-5 rubric. Reported threshold-3 binary F1 is 0.82 against synthetic teacher labels.
quality.uncertainty: Not independent human quality agreement. The card reports weaker fine-grained class prediction and possible academic-style bias.

difficulty_and_prerequisites.description: Difficulty for our target model is unknown.
difficulty_and_prerequisites.uncertainty: Requires probes and prerequisites calibrated to a specified model.

dependency_and_context.description: The relevant fact-to-answer distances and effects of truncation are unmeasured here.
dependency_and_context.uncertainty: Document length alone does not measure reasoning dependency length.

diversity_and_redundancy.description: The parent pipeline includes fuzzy deduplication, with the choice evaluated experimentally.
diversity_and_redundancy.uncertainty: Remaining semantic/template diversity is not independently measured here.

balance_and_exposure.description: The original research describes 15T parent and 1.3T Edu tokens; educational filtering changes the retained mix.
balance_and_exposure.uncertainty: These are historical release-scale figures, not current-corpus or per-task measurements.

annotation_trust.description: The scorer learns from Llama-generated annotations; its card documents evaluation and limitations.
annotation_trust.uncertainty: Transfer to another corpus/objective and agreement with humans remain separate questions.

leakage_and_generalization.description: No independent contamination or family-level leakage audit was run here.
leakage_and_generalization.uncertainty: Published benchmark results do not imply every possible downstream split is uncontaminated.

model_compatibility.description: Compatibility with our 80-character alphabet and short context has not been established.
model_compatibility.uncertainty: Encoding, context and preprocessing must be declared before combining the corpora.

empirical_utility.description: The general ablation setup matches 1.71B architectures and token budgets, using two seeds/subsets; larger comparisons use 350B tokens.
empirical_utility.uncertainty: Not replicated here and not a demonstrated gain for our character model.

access_and_reproducibility.description: Public dataset/classifier documentation and processing/evaluation resources are linked; compilation license is ODC-By.
access_and_reproducibility.uncertainty: Pin the actual selected dataset revision and preserve its terms before a new experiment.
